candidates.term: The Twin inside the Day Gate
candidates.defline: The Twin lives inside your Day Gate, the seat of your partner: you love as an equal, and only as an equal.
candidates.reading: At home you want two people deciding and neither one in charge, and you lose patience with a partner who leans on you for every choice. Because equality is how you feel respected, you track who conceded the last argument, and you rarely say so. Your friendships run on the same level terms, and you keep the friends a partner also respects. You grow easier about being looked after once someone has proved they stand level with you.
candidates.teaser: In love you need an equal, someone with a spine that matches yours. Marriage will feel like a partnership of captains, and it works when neither keeps score.

domain_readings.Love: In love you need a spine that matches yours: romance built on leaning never holds you, and admiration is your real aphrodisiac. The marriage that works is two captains with one map. Practice being carried occasionally. It is the single hardest and most bonding move available to you.
domain_readings.Social: Your social life routes through respect: friends earned as equals, kept as family, never collected. Couple-friendships suit you, allies of the household rather than audiences for it. Keep the circle small and the standards visible. People rise to them or rotate out, and both outcomes serve.

candidates.life_chapter: Your home chapter runs as a partnership of equals: the adult decades organize around a marriage or bond where neither leads by default. Expect the era’s lessons to be about yielding, not standing, you arrived already knowing how to stand. The households you build will be sturdy and frank.
candidates.relations: The spouse is this seat’s person, and they will be your match: strong-willed, capable, unimpressed by performance. In-laws and close friends read your household as a unit. Guard against score-keeping at close range. Equals keep ledgers by instinct, and love asks you to lose count.
candidates.turn_catalyst: Run thin, the equal bond underclaims: love held at arm’s length for safety. Close the distance first this season, on purpose.
candidates.turn_friction: Run heavy, the partnership turns contest: two captains, one wheel, daily elections. Hand over the wheel on alternating days.
candidates.shadow_line: Overloaded, intimacy becomes negotiation: affection with terms, warmth with a scoreboard.
candidates.health_line: Your body mirrors the household: it settles when home is level and knots when home contests. Peace at the table is physical medicine here.

Love.headline: You love best as an equal, or not at all.
Love.recognition: You want a partner with a full life of their own, and you go cold on anyone who needs you to lead. Because standing level is how you feel respected, you keep your own friends, money and plans inside the relationship. You find it harder to be carried, even for a day, than to carry yourself.
Love.lived: Your longest relationships so far have been with people who needed no rescuing, and the partners who leaned on you faded within a season. What you have built from them is a way of loving side by side, with neither of you walking behind.
Love.ahead: From your mid-thirties love becomes a partnership of two people who each run their own lives and still choose each other. You learn in these years to lean on a partner without feeling smaller, because you know you can stand on your own feet.
Love.lived_past: In your late thirties and forties your closest bonds were with people who needed no rescuing, and the partners who leaned on you faded within a season. From those years you built a way of loving side by side, with neither of you walking behind.

Social.headline: Your friends are few, level and loyal.
Social.recognition: Your closest friends are the few you would let into your home, people who stand level with you. Because an equal footing is what keeps you close to anyone, you let wider acquaintances fade without a word. You keep a small circle and can say why each person in it is there.
Social.lived: Your closest friendships so far have been between equals, people who never needed you to rescue them. You have kept every friendship level, with nothing owed in either direction.
Social.ahead: From your mid-thirties your circle narrows to a few people who meet you and a partner as equals and run lives of their own. By your forties you see fewer people than ever and trust each of them more.
Social.lived_past: In your late thirties and forties your closest friendships were between equals, people who never needed you to rescue them. You kept every friendship level, with nothing owed in either direction.

domains_round1_retired_2026-10-21.reading: At close range you need a partner who stands as tall as you, and you have never stayed long with someone who leans. Because equality is how you feel respected, your home runs with two people deciding and neither one in charge. The cost is a quiet tally of who did what, kept by both of you and spoken by neither. From your mid-thirties your private life settles around one level bond, and you grow easier about being looked after inside it.
